newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares close almost unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares close almost unchanged.

text.p: 1650 GMT - Italian shares closed well below the highs on Wednesday after reaching new record levels earlier in the day when a large sell order for Telecom Italia was executed just before the market closed.
* The all-share Mibtel index finished 0.13 percent higher at 13,494 with the blue chip Mib30 ending 0.08 percent down at 20,509.
* Telecom Italia closed 0.07 percent higher at 5,542 lire, down from a day's high of 5,800 lire. Earlier the stock had sunk to a low of 5,045 lire on the sell order.
* Shortly after the market closed AT&T Corp's President and CEO, John Walter, said it was premature to talk about the U.S. company acquiring a stake in Stet.
* The Italian government said earlier on Wednesday AT&T would become a shareholder in Stet once it was privatised in the autumn.
* Banks were again at the centre of attention with Ambroveneto making hefty gains with a rise of 8.48 percent to 5,336 lire. BCI rose 5.08 percent to 3,909 lire. Milan newsroom +392-61012321
